claims.citation: New York Herald, 11 May 1866, p. 9, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
Ship Adelaide (Br), Cutting, Liverpool April 9, with mdse
and 784 passengers, to Williams & Guion. One birth and one
death on passage. April 19, lat 48, lon 28, Wm Wills, sea-
man, fell overboard and was lost.
